description: Sort a code change that already landed onto specs that already exist. The change is a commit, a commit range, or the current branch diff. No dump is required. Quote what the change does into the matching spec.md files, then report whether docs/system/ or another spec has to change. Does not create a slug. Does not watch the repo. Does not seed docs/system/. When that folder exists and glossary.md is missing, fills only that file from the landed change. When the file exists, appends only words that are not already rows. Does not rewrite existing glossary rows. A meaning the change does not state is `to be researched`. Does not write application code. Does not plan, implement, or commit.
